reviewItem.question: Does "Handle `force: enabled` annotation in `flux diff ks` command by @stefanprodan in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5528" mean a change to protocol-behavior:flux|name=diff-ks-force-enabled (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: In Flux 2.7.0 the `flux diff ks` command now handles the `force: enabled` annotation, so its diff behaviour for Kustomizations carrying that annotation differs from earlier releases.
